If you've been waiting for the right downtown condo at the right price, this may be the one.

Experience modern luxury, convenience, and incredible value in this spacious, move-in ready downtown condo. Ideally located in the heart of the city, this beautifully updated 2-bedroom, 2-bath residence offers the style, space, and amenities today's buyers are looking for.

The recently renovated kitchen features gorgeous quartz countertops, newer stainless steel appliances, and a large breakfast bar that's perfect for casual meals, entertaining, or your morning coffee. Rich wood floors add warmth and character, while the expansive living room—with its beautiful fireplace—provides an inviting space to relax and unwind. In-unit laundry with a newer washer and dryer makes everyday living even easier.

The amenities don't stop there! Enjoy secure front entry, Ring video access throughout major areas of the building, a dedicated package/mail room, freight elevator for easy moving, private storage, and gated parking with electric vehicle charging available at each space.

And there's even more value to appreciate. A recent reassessment has resulted in **lower property taxes**, making this already attractive condo even more affordable.

**Great location. Updated interior. Incredible amenities. Lower taxes. A seller willing to make a deal. 

**Don't wait for someone else to recognize the value—come see it for yourself!**
